gloss: mild case; minor illness; minor injury

definitions.gloss: mild case; minor illness; minor injury
definitions.explanation: A condition, illness, or injury that is not severe and does not require intensive treatment. The opposite of 重症.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧{軽症|けいしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}んだ→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: Fortunately, it was only a minor injury.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染者|かんせんしゃ}→感染者：28388_kansensha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{軽症|けいしょう}だった。
examples.english: Most of the infected people had mild cases.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{運|はこ}ばれた→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦いずれも→いずれも：16830_izuremo⟧{軽症|けいしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{命|いのち}→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{別状|べつじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Three people were taken to the hospital after the accident, but all had minor injuries and their lives are not in danger.

notes:
Compound of {軽|けい} (light, mild) + {症|しょう} (symptom, illness). Antonym: ⟦{重症|じゅうしょう}→重症：09792_juushou⟧ (serious/critical condition).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軽症|けいしょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧ (to get off with only minor injuries)
- {軽症|けいしょう}⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧ (patient with a mild case)
- {軽症|けいしょう}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person with minor injuries/illness)

SEVERITY SCALE:
{軽症|けいしょう} (mild) → {中等症|ちゅうとうしょう} (moderate) → ⟦{重症|じゅうしょう}→重症：09792_juushou⟧ (severe) → ⟦{重篤|じゅうとく}→重篤：21643_juutoku⟧ (critical)

USAGE:
Commonly seen in news reports about accidents and disease outbreaks. Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{継承|けいしょう}→継承：13841_keishou⟧ (succession, inheritance).
